climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A hillside AVA on the western edge of the Valley of the Moon in southern Sonoma County, around a 2,463-foot mountain and the town of Glen Ellen. Many microclimates in its folds and ridges suit Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon and Zinfandel.
